input: A WhatsApp-first community product for Indian college students learning AI skills
productSummary: A WhatsApp-first community product for Indian college students learning AI skills. The brief does not specify the learning experience, target outcome, or monetization model.

questions.text: What exactly do students do in the WhatsApp community, and what measurable AI-learning outcome should they achieve?
Which college students are the initial ICP—year of study, discipline, AI-skill level, cities or regions, and preferred languages?
How large is the existing community, and what initial student cohort or community size should the launch target?
